product.title: Half Day Canyoneering Tour in Egypt Slot Canyon

description.text: In Bryce Canyon National Park, Egypt 1 offers a lot packed into a short approach and exit. Those with high skill levels can downclimb the entire canyon. Stops include Egypt Slot Canyon. Others will do 3 short rappels. Ideal for visitors basing near Bryce Canyon City who want a guided red-rock experience without coordinating park entrances, trailheads, or photo stops on their own. Routes stay oriented to Bryce Canyon hoodoo amphitheaters, rim overlooks, and southern Utah red-rock corridors that define the park.
